text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Duramente reported to her family's circle that 
she would not be taking on the Arc de Triomphe this year either.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
When she said she had let their hopes down, 
her family told her they supported her choice. 
They praised her resolve to shoulder everything.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Filled with the warmth of everyone's feelings, Duramente 
swore once more to carry the name of "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
At the Takarazuka Kinen, the ones standing 
in Duramente's way were the rivals of her own year.
